name: Day Ticket
summary:
Day Ticket is a carp focused fishing game for Playdate.

Choose a venue, cast your line, watch the water, and strike when the reel runs. Once hooked, each fish becomes a hands-on fight: use the crank and buttons to manage tension, give line, tire the fish, and land it without snapping.

Earn coins from catches, upgrade your tackle, and unlock tougher waters as you build your carp fishing setup. Weather, wind, lake beds, bait, and gear all affect how a session plays out.

A full playable tutorial teaches the flow step by step, from casting and striking to fighting, netting, using the tackle shop, and saving your game.

Calm, compact, and skill-based, Day Ticket is made for players who like fishing games with patience, pressure, and progression.
